scores.eval_notes: Table 1 'Analysis of Pre-training' (Sec. 3.4, GE-Act on AgiBot G1): row VidAW ✓ (init from GE-Base) + VidAda ✓ (task-specific video adaptation), 'w/ S' (robot state as input) column. Text: 'in-domain pretraining achieves 64 SR and 81 E2E, which further improve to 76% and 89% when combined with general video pretraining.' Values printed as fractions. Metrics: E2E = end-to-end success of the complete task (retries of sub-steps allowed); SR = step-wise success (completed sub-steps / total). No CALVIN or LIBERO results in the paper (v1-v3) despite the Dec-2025 release of 'GE-Act trained on Calvin' weights.
